arxiv-2207-03864.title: Impact of granular inclusions on the phase behavior of colloidal gels
arxiv-2207-03864.creator: Yankai Li, John R. Royer, Jin Sun, Christopher Ness
arxiv-2207-03864.description: Abstract Colloidal gels formed from small attractive particles are commonly used in formulations to keep larger components in suspension. However, despite extensive work characterizing unfilled gels, little is known about how larger inclusions alter the phase behavior and microstructure of the colloidal system.

arxiv-2211-10025.title: Multiuser-MIMO Systems Using Comparator Network-Aided Receivers With 1-Bit Quantization
arxiv-2211-10025.creator: Ana Beatriz L. B. Fernandes, Zhichao Shao, Lukas T. N. Landau, and Rodrigo C. de Lamare
arxiv-2211-10025.description: Abstract Low-resolution analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) are promising for reducing energy consumption and costs of multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems with many antennas. We propose low-resolution multiuser MIMO receivers where the signals are simultaneously processed by 1-bit ADCs and a comparator network, which can be interpreted as additional virtual channels with binary outputs.

arxiv-2308-06555.title: Simply tell me how—On Trustworthiness and Technology Acceptance of Attribute-Based Credentials
arxiv-2308-06555.creator: Rachel Crowder, George Price, Thomas Groß
arxiv-2308-06555.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Rachel Crowder, George Price, Thomas Groß. Attribute-Based Credential Systems (ACS) have been long proposed as privacy-preserving means of attribute-based authentication, yet neither been considered particularly usable nor found wide-spread adoption, to date. To establish what variables drive the adoption of ACS as a usable security and privacy technology, we investigated how intrinsic and presentation properties impact their perceived trustworthiness and behavioral intent to adopt them. We conducted two confirmatory, fractional-factorial, between-subject, random-controlled trials with a total UK-representative sample of N = 812 N=812 participants.

arxiv-2403-12091.title: Deformation of power law in the double Pareto distribution using uniformly distributed observation time
arxiv-2403-12091.creator: Ken Yamamoto, Takashi Bando, Hirokazu Yanagawa, Yoshihiro Yamazaki
arxiv-2403-12091.description: Abstract The double Pareto distribution is a heavy-tailed distribution with a power-law tail, that is generated via geometric Brownian motion with an exponentially distributed observation time. In this study, we examine a modified model wherein the exponential distribution of the observation time is replaced with a continuous uniform distribution.

arxiv-2403-16266.title: What are the quantum commutation relations for the total angular momentum of light? Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2403-16266.creator: Pronoy Das, 1 Li-Ping Yang, 2 and Zubin Jacob 1,*
arxiv-2403-16266.description: Abstract The total angular momentum of light has received attention for its application in a variety of phenomena such as optical communication, optical forces and sensing. However, the quantum behavior including the commutation relations have been relatively less explored. Here, we derive the correct commutation relation for the total angular momentum of light using both relativistic and non-relativistic approaches.

arxiv-2406-20060.title: Applying RLAIF for Code Generation with API-usage in Lightweight LLMs
arxiv-2406-20060.creator: Sujan Dutta, Sayantan Mahinder, Raviteja Anantha, Bortik Bandyopadhyay
arxiv-2406-20060.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) has demonstrated significant potential across various domains, including mitigating harm in LLM outputs, enhancing text summarization, and mathematical reasoning. This paper introduces an RLAIF framework for improving the code generation abilities of lightweight (<1B parameters) LLMs.

arxiv-2504-04296.creator: René García-Lara
arxiv-2504-04296.description: Abstract Existence of abelian BPS vortices on a manifold with boundary satisfying Neumann boundary conditions is proved. pmc-12648055.description: Uterine smooth muscle tumour of uncertain malignant potential (STUMP) is a rare and diagnostically challenging entity, lying on the spectrum between benign leiomyomas and malignant leiomyosarcomas. pmc-12749868.title: Reliable wrist PPG monitoring by mitigating poor skin sensor contact
pmc-12749868.creator: Hung Manh Pham, Matthew Yiwen Ho, Yiming Zhang, Dimitris Spathis, Aaqib Saeed, Dong Ma
pmc-12749868.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Photoplethysmography (PPG) is a widely used non-invasive technique for monitoring cardiovascular health and various physiological parameters on consumer and medical devices. While motion artifacts are well-known challenges in dynamic settings, suboptimal skin-sensor contact in sedentary conditions - an important issue often overlooked in existing literature - can distort PPG signal morphology, leading to the loss or shift of essential waveform features and therefore degrading sensing performance.
